headline: Eazy-E would’ve turned 62 years old today. Happy heavenly birthday to a West Coast legend
body: Eazy-E would’ve turned 62 years old today. Happy heavenly birthday to a West Coast legend 🕊️❤️ From putting Compton on the map with N.W.A to building Ruthless Records, Eazy helped create a movement that changed hip-hop forever. His unmistakable voice, personality and willingness to push boundaries made him one of rap’s most recognizable figures. His legacy also lives on through the artists he helped introduce to the world, including Bone Thugs-N-Harmony. More than three decades after his passing, his impact is still felt across generations. Forever remembered. Rest easy, Eazy. 🙏 What’s your favorite Eazy-E track? 🎶
